items.label: A Moroccan banking leader
items.challenge: End-of-life Avaya on-premise infrastructure, telecoms costs up 40% over three years, zero real-time reporting for supervisors.
items.mission: Migration to Genesys Cloud CX + Salesforce CRM integration
items.deployment: We started with a complete technical audit of the existing Avaya infrastructure — call flow mapping, migration risk identification and design of the target Genesys Cloud architecture. The cutover took place in 10% waves over ten weeks, with dual-running maintained until each batch was fully validated. Salesforce CRM integration was deployed in parallel, connecting the customer record in real time within Genesys. The final go-live took place on a Sunday evening with no visible interruption for the bank's customers.
items.quote: The phased 10% wave cutover allowed us to keep every line active. At no point did our customers notice the transition.

items.label: A leading national insurer
items.challenge: CSAT at 6.2/10, call abandonment rate at 34%, negative NPS. Customer journeys had not been reviewed in five years.
items.mission: Omnichannel CX audit + journey redesign + quick win deployment
items.deployment: We conducted a six-week omnichannel CX audit: listening to 400 calls, analysing chat and email verbatims, mapping 12 distinct customer journeys. Prioritisation was based on ROI impact and implementation complexity — quick wins were deployed from week 4: IVR rewrite, reduction of internal transfers, optimised agent scripts. The second phase integrated an automatic callback module and a real-time supervisor dashboard, drastically reducing the abandonment rate.
items.quote: We had intuitions about our CX weaknesses. One-X quantified and prioritised them. The quick wins convinced our management team by week six.

items.label: A major Moroccan operator
items.challenge: 65% of calls were about simple queries: account balance, tariff plans, invoices. Agents were overloaded with low-value volume.
items.mission: NLU voicebot deployment + real-time agent assist on Genesys
items.deployment: The project began by identifying the 15 most frequent call reasons representing 65% of volume. We designed and deployed an NLU voicebot on Genesys, capable of handling requests in natural language without a rigid decision tree. An Agent Assist module was integrated into the agent interface, displaying real-time response suggestions based on call transcription. Agents were trained over two days to adopt the new human/AI dynamic.
items.quote: Our agents finally handle complex requests. The bot manages the volume, they manage the relationship. That's exactly the split we were looking for.

items.question: How much does a CCaaS migration to Genesys Cloud or AWS Connect cost in Morocco?
items.answer:
The cost of a CCaaS migration depends on several factors: number of agents (20–500+), complexity of CRM integrations (Salesforce, Dynamics, custom), and target platform (Genesys Cloud, AWS Connect, Avaya).

**Ballpark figures:**
- **Full CCaaS audit**: 15,000 MAD ex. VAT (deducted if project signed)
- **Migration 20–50 agents**: From 150,000 MAD ex. VAT (fixed-price project)
- **Migration 50–200 agents**: 300,000–800,000 MAD ex. VAT
- **Migration 200–500+ agents**: On quote (complex architecture)

**Included:** Cloud architecture, platform configuration, CRM integrations, phased migration, agent training, 30-day post go-live support.

**Note:** We bill on a fixed-price project basis (no time-and-materials), with measurable positive ROI through telecom savings (−20 to −40%).

items.question: How long does a contact centre cloud migration take?
items.answer:
Migration duration varies by centre size and technical complexity:

**Typical timeline:**
- **Phase 1 – Audit & Architecture**: 2 weeks
- **Phase 2 – Configuration & Testing**: 3–4 weeks
- **Phase 3 – Phased Migration**: 2–4 weeks (10% agents per wave)
- **Phase 4 – Optimisation & Support**: 1 month post go-live

**Total duration:** **8 to 12 weeks** (2–3 months) from audit to full go-live.

**Acceleration factors:**
- Existing cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure already in place)
- Standardised CRM integrations (Salesforce/Dynamics)
- Available IT team for testing

**One-X commitment:** Week-by-week roadmap from day one of audit. No delays except client-initiated change requests.

items.question: Can we migrate to Genesys Cloud or AWS Connect without interrupting customer service?
items.answer:
**Yes — this is our standard method.**

**Our "Zero Downtime" approach:**
1. **Phased migration by waves**: 10% of agents per day (no "big bang")
2. **Temporary dual-running**: Old and new platform running in parallel during transition
3. **Real load testing**: 120% of normal traffic simulated before cut-over
4. **Documented rollback plan**: Revert possible in < 30 min if critical issue arises
5. **24/7 support first week**: Dedicated team post go-live

**Result:** Across hundreds of projects managed, **0 major production incidents**, SLA 99.95%+ maintained.

**One-X guarantee:** If unplanned downtime exceeds 1 hour, contractual penalties apply (partial refund).

items.question: Genesys Cloud, AWS Connect or Avaya Cloud: which CCaaS platform should you choose?
items.answer:
**There is no single "best" CCaaS. The right choice depends on YOUR constraints.**

**Quick comparison:**
- **Genesys Cloud**: Large enterprises (200+ agents), advanced omnichannel, powerful AI. Price: €150–200/agent/month.
- **AWS Connect**: Tech startups, native AWS integrations, optimised cost. Price: €80–120/agent/month.
- **Avaya Cloud**: Migration from Avaya on-premises, smooth transition. Price: €100–150/agent/month.

**Our recommendation by profile:**
- **50–200 agents + strong omnichannel need** → **Genesys Cloud**
- **Already on AWS + strong tech team** → **AWS Connect**
- **Migrating from Avaya on-premises** → **Avaya Cloud**

**One-X service:** Free 30-min diagnostic to compare all three against your criteria (budget, agent count, CRM, timeline). Objective recommendation — we receive no vendor commission.

items.question: Why choose a local CCaaS consultancy in Morocco over an international integrator?
items.answer:
**3 concrete reasons:**

**1. Responsiveness & Availability**
- **Local firm (One-X)**: Team in Casablanca, on-site interventions within 48 hours, French/Arabic support, same time zone
- **International integrator**: Consultants based in Paris/London, expensive travel, time-zone lag, limited availability

**2. Controlled Costs**
- **Local firm**: Daily rate 5,000–8,000 MAD (€500–800), no travel expenses
- **International integrator**: Daily rate €1,500–2,500 + mission costs (flights, hotel) → **Total cost ×2 to ×3**

**3. Morocco Context Knowledge**
- ANRT telecom regulations
- Local banking/insurance sector specificities
- Moroccan contact centre HR practices
- Local vendor ecosystem (connectivity, SIP trunking)

**Our positioning:** International expertise (trained on major France/Europe projects) + local Morocco delivery = best of both worlds.
